ValidationRule.description: CRN and VAT Number must be 9 characters long with ONLY Numbers.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && RecordType.DeveloperName = "ER_Company_Account_RT" && ISPICKVAL(ER_BUPicklist__c, "GR") && ISPICKVAL(ER_Country_Code__c, "GR") && (NOT(ISBLANK(ER_Registration_Number__c)) && ((NOT(REGEX(ER_Registration_Number__c, "^[0-9]*$")) || LEN(ER_Registration_Number__c) <> 9) ) || (NOT(ISBLANK(ER_VAT_Number__c)) && (NOT(REGEX(ER_VAT_Number__c, "^[0-9]*$")) || LEN(ER_VAT_Number__c) <> 9) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: VRGR03 - CRN and VAT Number must be 9 characters long with only numbers.
